title: Andrea Brillantes' 'Laya' to open in cinemas on November 25
summary: Sigrid Andrea P. Bernardo’s upcoming film “Laya,” which stars Andrea Brillantes, JC Santos and Anthony Jennings, is set to hit cinemas on November 25.
